cases.sentence: На ___ мальчику должно быть сделано обрезание.
cases.explain: «восьмой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: In the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

cases.sentence: Пусть она не прикасается к ___ и не ходит в святилище, пока не пройдут дни очищения.
cases.explain: «священным предметам» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: She shall continue in the blood of purification thirty-three days. She shall not touch any holy thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying are completed.

cases.sentence: Если ей не по средствам принести ягненка, пусть принесет пару горлиц или двух ___, одного для всесожжения, а другого в жертву за грех.
cases.explain: «молодых голубей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: If she cannot afford a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons: the one for a burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering. The priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be clean.’ ”
